title: Mike W NDE 39
content: Events surrounding NDE: I was in a car accident in 1968 and taken to the hospital critical care unit. Describe in detail the events (in order) that happened: As I left the room, I was sort of aware of the people behind working on my body. I was propelled towards a tunnel with a small light at the end of it. As I got closer to the light, it got brighter and larger. At the end of the tunnel, and it seemed that one second I was at the beginning of the light and the next I was out in the light, as if I went from zero to one hundred like that. The place I was in was almost hard to describe. It was a beautiful sunshiny day, and it was a large area of golden long stemmed grass or wheat field with flowers interspaced throughout the place. I was moving over this place and being guided towards a big beautiful tree out in the middle of all this. I got to the tree, and sitting on large rock was my dad's dead father. He died when I was three or four years old. Even though I was seventeen at the time and good size, I was sitting on my grandfather's knees. It really felt good to be there with him. All pain and everything else was gone except for us. He told me that I would have to go back to my life, as there were things that I must do. I said to him that I did not want to go back, and he said that he loved me and that I must go back. At that time, I moved off from his lap and was moving back away from the tree. He and the tree got smaller and about that time, I was back in my body. I didn't learn from my mother about this in my conscious state until later when I described certain physical features about my grandfather to her.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt propelled toward a tunnel while aware of people working on his body.

environment.environment_other_detail: Golden long-stemmed grass or wheat field with flowers; big beautiful tree; "beautiful sunshiny day."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told he must go back because "there were things that I must do."

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with awareness of people working on his body, then propelled through a tunnel toward a light, emerged into a bright pastoral field, guided to a tree where he met his deceased grandfather, then told he must return and was back in his body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He later described physical features of his deceased grandfather to his mother, which he had not consciously learned from her until after the experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was propelled towards a tunnel with a small light at the end of it." "It was a beautiful sunshiny day, and it was a large area of golden long stemmed grass or wheat field with flowers interspaced throughout the place." "He told me that I would have to go back to my life, as there were things that I must do."
